Deploy and maintain BGP sessions across WAN, public, and datacenter network environments. Investigate and troubleshoot network incidents while minimizing customer impact and service disruption. review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with routing and switching, BGP, Juniper network technologies, and datacenter environments.
